cards.name: N's Zekrom

lp.src: Avg of last 3 TCGplayer LP sales ($55.96 09/21, $55.95 09/18, $60.65 08/25); LP market $80.01 anomalous (above NM)

mp.src: ~75% of NM; MP market $68.72 and thin sales ($55 09/06, $69.99 08/04; 3 sales/qtr) sit above LP

dmg.src: ~35% of NM; only 1 DMG sale ($52 09/16), market $52.44 anomalous (above MP)

cards.gem: Not published yet by grade; ~2,625 graded across all graders (GemRate). A 9.5 sells ~$612 vs ~$109 for a 9, so 10s look scarce.

pop.src: No PSA/CGC breakdown on PriceCharting yet (new 2026 promo)

cards.notes: Only a PSA 10 makes money (~+$3,550); a 9 loses about $41 and an 8 about $79. PSA 10s sell several times a week, but no gem rate is published yet, so the odds of a 10 are unknown. Grade only copies with perfect centering and clean holo surfaces. Make sure it's the Pokémon Center stamped version, not the regular #031.
